Question_text: In this experiment, you will investigate the motion of a wooden block on a ramp. You have been provided with • a wooden block with a face labelled A, • a length of wood that can be used to form a ramp, • a stand and boss holding a rod that can be used to support the ramp, • a metre rule, • a mass of 200 g, • a piece of Blu-Tack, • a set square.
